rows.text: sets `r8d` to 1 and tail-jumps at `00422E40` + 0x6 with the incoming `rcx` and `rdx` unchanged

notes: 00422E40 (doubt, minor): the body is two instructions; the r8d store is the entry instruction and cannot be anchored, so the single anchor is the tail jump. If FABLE treats a two-instruction thunk as entry-only work, skip it instead.
